bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest recent Bears story is tight end Cole Kmet being placed on injured reserve with a season-ending knee injury suffered in Chicago's 30-24 win over the Patriots, while defensive lineman Montez Sweat's suspension has been lifted by the Commissioner. Cole Kmet is officially out for the season with a knee injury, and Ben Johnson has no regrets about the trick play in the Week 7 win.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions defeated the Green Bay Packers 20-17, with Jared Goff named Tom Brady's LFG Player of the Game after throwing for 303 yards and two touchdowns in the win , while the team also got key reinforcements back as Cade Mays, who broke his wrist in training camp, was activated with Dan Campbell indicating plans to put Mays back in the lineup after Juice Scruggs had filled in at center . Looking ahead, the Lions are now shifting focus to a tough Week 8 matchup, with Jameson Williams carrying momentum into a tough Week 8 matchup against the unbeaten Vikings after breaking out for a strong stretch of games following the bye week .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers have signed guard Mekhi Becton Sr. to the active roster and placed center/guard Jacob Monk on injured reserve ahead of Thursday night's Week 8 matchup against the Carolina Panthers, as the team's offensive line continues to be hit by injuries.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings improved to a league-best 6-0 after a gritty 16-10 win over the Indianapolis Colts, with the Vikings defeating the Indianapolis Colts 16-10 at U.S. Bank Stadium to improve to 6-0 in Week 7 , as the Vikings are now the only undefeated team in the NFL following the results of all the Week 7 games around the league .
